name: Lombok
blurb: Conversation about Lombok is up 232% on its six-month baseline, driven by travellers describing it as a calmer alternative to nearby hotspots. Most posts mention beaches, value and the shoulder season.

positive: Quieter than the better-known spots nearby
Food repeatedly singled out as a highlight
negative: Cheap accommodation getting harder to find

quotes.text: The food alone would be worth the trip.
Getting harder to find a decent room under budget this year.
Spent a week here working remotely, wifi was fine everywhere.
